ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: My Journal uses Face ID to unlock your journal.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: My Journal needs access to your photos so you can add pictures to your entries.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: My Journal needs the camera so you can take photos for your entries.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your consent lets us show you more relevant ads. Your journal entries are never shared.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: My Journal uses the microphone so you can record voice notes for your entries. Recordings stay on your device.
